slices.focus: Marcus invites Eric to a low-key weekend catch at a park that turns into impromptu pickup softball, reconnecting Eric to the physical enjoyment of playing rather than spectating, with the simple commitment of keeping his glove in the car.
slices.summary: A casual park catch with Marcus and former college friends reawakens Eric's enjoyment of playing softball rather than just watching, leading to a low-friction commitment: glove stays in the car, and he says yes when an opening appears.
open_loops: Whether to tell Marcus the invitation mattered more than he probably knows
Whether the glove-in-car system will actually result in repeat outings
